name: Shin'ya 0-ji no Regret
source:
Several of my classmates have gone missing.
They all were the noisy, delinquent kind.
Seems none of them have even been home since yesterday.
I hated them. I wanted them to die.

They were killed because of me.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5513]NovelGame[/url]]
